Subject: Plan recommendation and pricing request — ScaleBurst

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited by the product fit and the latency requirements you mentioned. I pulled together two practical packaging options that we see work well for customers with spiky inference needs:

Option A — Reserved + Burst Credits
- 12-month reserved capacity (2x gpus equivalent sustained) for baseline throughput
- Metered burst credits for short-term peaks (billed separately, pre-purchase bundles)
- Predictable unit cost for baseline, flexible for peaks

Option B — Metered with Auto-Burst
- No reservation; usage billed per token at tiered rates
- Autoscaling pools for peak; higher marginal cost but no commit

Quick ask: could you share an expected peak minute-level RPS or estimated peak token volume for a typical campaign window? That will help us size the reserved tier vs estimated burst credit needs.

I attached the usage worksheet you shared during the call and filled in a couple of assumptions (ScaleBurst_MATP_v1.xlsx) — take a look and tell me what numbers you want us to bake into a formal SOW.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm a reasonable peak estimate (tokens/min or concurrent requests)
2) We propose a concrete sizing + pricing (incl. standard discount tiers)
3) If you need a special first-year incentive we can evaluate a one-time onboarding credit

Thanks,
Ben

Thanks for the context — Emily, the numbers look straightforward. Quick notes from product sizing perspective:

- Peak sizing: 40 concurrent @ ~3.5k tokens = ~140k tokens/min (your 160k is a safe upper bound).
- Recommended baseline: 2x A100-equivalent reserved instances (keeps KV cache warm, low latency) — covers sustained load and short bursts; we should size burst credits for 300k tokens/min headroom to be safe.

Cost sketch (very rough):
Option A (Reserved + Burst)
- Reserved (2 GPUs sustained) => estimated baseline cost: $6,400/month (includes KV cache overhead and GA model choice)
- Burst credits (pre-bundled 1M tokens/month as cushion) => $900/month at list for this pack
- Total list ~ $7,300/mo (~$87,600/yr) before discounts; additional overage at metered rate if exceeded

Option B (Metered with Auto-Burst)
- Metered only => estimated $0.0009/token for peak models => with expected usage this could hit ~$110k–$140k/yr depending on actual campaign cadence

Operational note: Option A provides predictable base cost and generally better latency during spikes because of warmed caches. Option B avoids commit but is less predictable.

I can produce a more detailed per-week simulation if you can share a 24-hr traffic sample.

— Priyom
Lead Product Manager, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

Ben / team,

Thanks — based on the product sketch, here are the pricing levers and what we can authorize without senior approval:

Standard discounts (first-year, list-based):
- < $50k ARR: up to 10% discount
- $50k–$250k ARR: up to 15% discount (typical for mid-market)
- > $250k ARR: 15–25% depending on term length and features

For ScaleBurst (target ~$120k ARR) the playbook allows us to price at 15% discount without escalation. A 20% discount would require manager approval because it's outside the standard sales allowance. Alternatively, we can offer a $10k onboarding credit in lieu of a deeper percent discount — that often aligns better with procurement asks because it preserves list pricing.

Compliance/SOW: I attached a short checklist for retention/audit items we need in the SOW (auditLogClause.txt excerpt). If they need SOC-level artifacts we should route to security for the pack.

If you want me to prepare a 20% exception request, confirm the ARR and commit term (12 or 24 months) and I'll file the approval.

Evelyn
